name: Heavy Eyelid
description: Weigh down a foe's eyelids with dream force until the foe's focus slackens.

name: Sleeper Count
description: Count the sleepers in the surrounding dwellings by the soft pulse of their dreams.

name: Counterpane Ward
description: Draw a heavy counterpane of dream force over the self that smothers the edge of a strike.

name: Nap Mending
description: Put an ally into a short deep nap that closes small cuts and eases a tired body.

name: Deep Slumber
description: Sink a weakened foe into a deep slumber that holds as long as the user keeps the dream.

name: Nightmare Easing
description: Coax the terror of a recurring nightmare out of an ally's sleep and out of the ally's waking mind.

name: Dream Slip
description: Slip sideways through the thin skin between waking and dream for a short sudden step.

name: Dreamer's Ear
description: Tune the mind to the dreams of those nearby and hear which of them are troubled or still.

name: Gauze Ward
description: Hang a gauze of dream force in front of the body that turns a thrust into a drifting blur.

name: Cloudy Mind
description: Cloud a foe's thinking with a drift of dream force so the foe mistakes friend for foe.

name: Pillow Mend
description: Lay an ally's head on a pillow of dream force and let the rest knit a minor wound.

name: Rousing Flash
description: Flash a bright image through a flagging ally's mind and rouse the ally to full alertness.

name: Pocket Dream
description: Fold a foe's mind into a small pocket of dream where the foe sleepwalks in place.

name: Haze Walk
description: Walk through the dream layer for a short stretch so the body crosses ground unseen by waking eyes.

name: Fitful Sense
description: Feel the restless tossing of a fretful sleeper's mind to learn what the sleeper fears.

name: Restless Calm
description: Lay a calm over a restless sleeper until the sleeper's pulse slows and strain fades.

name: Soothing Rally
description: Rally a frightened ally's nerve with a soothing wash of dream force.

name: Thin Veil
description: Pull a thin veil of dream force over a sleeper so a hostile dream finds no purchase.

name: Fretful Haze
description: Breathe a fretful haze into a foe's mind so the foe's own fears cloud the foe's aim.

name: Fear Draining
description: Drain a lingering terror from an ally's mind in long slow pulls until the ally breathes freely.

name: Nightmare Undoing
description: Unpick the weight of a nightmare thread by thread until the ally wakes light and rested.

name: Lucid Eye
description: Open a lucid eye inside a dream and see at once that the dream is only a dream.

name: Dream Anchor
description: Drop an anchor of will in the dream so a hostile dreamer cannot drag the user away.

name: Steady Dream
description: Hold an ally's dream steady and clear so the ally learns to act inside it.

name: Idle Drift
description: Nudge a foe's thoughts into a slow idle drift that breaks the rhythm of the foe's attack.

name: Dreamer's Ease
description: Ease an ally's aches inside a lucid dream where the body feels no pain.

name: Dream Rap
description: Strike a foe's mind with a hard bolt of dream force that jars the foe's senses.

name: Lucid Command
description: Speak a command that a dreaming foe takes for the foe's own thought and obeys for a breath.

name: Rewritten Scene
description: Rewrite the scene of a hostile dream as it begins so the foe's snare falls away from the user.

name: Lucid Footing
description: Give an ally firm lucid ground inside a shared dream so the ally acts with full will.

name: Shared Doze
description: Pass a shared drowse across two foes at once so both slow in the same moment.

name: Dream Link
description: Link the user's mind to an ally's dream and see through the ally's sleeping eyes.

name: Joint Veil
description: Draw one veil of dream force over the user and a sleeping ally so both are screened.

name: Common Rest
description: Share the user's own rest with a wounded ally in a dream held by both of them.

name: Tangled Sleep
description: Tangle a foe in a dream of thick vines so the foe's limbs lag in the waking world.

name: Mirrored Sleep
description: Copy the user's calm into an ally's sleeping mind so the ally wakes with the same strength.

name: Linked Step
description: Step through a shared dream to the side of a linked ally in a single quick pace.

name: Shared Ordeal
description: Drag a foe into a dream where the foe suffers a trial of the foe's own fears.

name: Dream Healing
description: Mend a wounded ally inside a shared dream where the body takes the healing to heart.

name: Dream Cleansing
description: Wash a poison or a dread from an ally's body in a clean shared dream.
